reviewer: Codex AI, source-compared; NOT human developer approved or clinician validated
resultLookup: Match caseId, set, promptVersion and layout to audit.json, then open requestSha256/{record,request,response,parsed}.json. raw response text is evaluated even when parsing fails; it is NOT a deliverable service result.
factStatusMeaning: R=retained in summary/details; P=partially retained, ambiguity or missing qualifier; M=missing; C=contradicted. Fact status does NOT assert evidence correctness. Facts correspond to .ko.json facts, not clinician notes. Composite facts use conservative whole-group assessment.
scores: readability/reportFit: 0 poor, 1 partial/repetitive/technical, 2 clear and direct. These are AI judgments, not clinical grades. No aggregate safety score masks individual errors.
